visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women, one blonde and one with black hair, stand cheerfully in a modern living room. The blonde wears a white fuzzy sweater and the other wears a red cardigan. They wave enthusiastically at the camera, their facial expressions filled with joy and excitement. A plush teddy bear sits prominently on the sofa behind them in a warm, brightly lit domestic setting. (2) The girls begin a DIY project by placing empty plastic water bottles on top of their heads as structural bases. They carefully pull their long hair upwards to cover the bottles, creating a tall conical shape like a small tree. The blonde woman helps her friend secure the hair with elastic bands, showing focused yet playful facial expressions while the variety text overlays explain the steps. (3) The initial hair structures are successfully finished, and the two women pose to show off the vertical cones. The dark-haired woman looks into the camera with a surprised and happy expression, while the blonde woman laughs heartily. The lighting is bright and soft, highlighting the fuzzy textures of their holiday sweaters and the neutral tones of the brown sofa. (4) They start wrapping shiny metallic tinsel around the hair cones to simulate colorful tree foliage. The blonde woman uses gold tinsel, while the black-haired woman uses a vibrant pink material. They wind the decorations from bottom to top, using their hands to ensure even coverage across the hair surface. The background remains a tidy indoor apartment setting with consistent warm lighting. (5) Various Christmas ornaments, including red balls, tiny gift boxes, and gold stars, are clipped onto the tinsel. The women take turns decorating each other's hair-trees, laughing and interacting closely. Close-up shots capture the small details of the plastic ornaments and their careful hand movements. The teddy bear remains a constant background element throughout this festive decorating phase. (6) A string of small battery-operated fairy lights is added to the hairstyles to provide a glowing finish. One woman holds the transparent battery pack while the other wraps the thin copper wire around the decorated hair-tree. They also use a curling iron to style loose strands of hair, maintaining a high level of energy and festive spirit while interacting with the camera. (7) The final reveal features the room lights turned off to show the glowing hair-trees in a festive, low-light atmosphere. They pose for several final photos, winking and smiling at the lens. The video concludes with a series of still photographs showcasing the completed DIY project from different angles, followed by a final wave and holiday greeting to the audience.
